meta.title: A Little Further
meta.audience: My family (especially my mother) and relatives in Ethiopia and the diaspora, watching on a phone in WhatsApp/Telegram; secondary: peers and colleagues on LinkedIn/Slack.
meta.intent: At the end, viewers feel that one person's achievement is the accumulated sacrifice of many generations, and that the story is not finished: it is the narrator's turn to carry the family a little further.
meta.logline: Four generations in Harar, from immigrant tailors to a software engineer, each giving up something so the next could go a little further.

locations.description: The old stone wall of Harar's walled city (Jugol), limewashed stone, a narrow winding alley of inward-facing two-storey houses, plain walls, no signage.

fact_flags.claim: Jugol: stone wall, narrow alleys, inward-facing two-storey houses; limewashed walls in early eras

locations.description: An open-air market in old Harar with stalls under overhanging roofs and simple wooden sheds, bundles of cloth, woven baskets and sacks, people in modest everyday clothing, warm dusty light.

fact_flags.claim: tailors and traders worked in the open air or under sheds and overhanging roofs; textiles, baskets and spices sold in Harar markets

shots.purpose: Establish place and time: the film begins where the family's story begins, at Harar's old walls.

shots.lighting: first light of dawn, soft gold on pale stone, cool shadows
shots.composition: the alley's vanishing point centred; safe for 9:16 and 16:9 crops

keyframe.prompt: Extreme wide view at dawn of the old stone wall of a walled Ethiopian city and a narrow alley leading inside, empty street, first golden light on the stones.

motion.prompt: The camera pushes in very slowly. Morning light gradually brightens on the stone walls. A little dust drifts in the air.

narration.text: Every family has a beginning. Ours begins at the old walls of Harar.

keyframe.prompt: Wide shot from behind of a young couple carrying cloth bundles, walking along a dusty road toward the old stone wall of the city in morning light.

motion.prompt: The couple walk slowly forward, away from the camera. The camera follows gently at walking pace. Their clothes move softly in the breeze.

shots.purpose: Show their contribution, a livelihood made by hand, and introduce the thread motif.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of a tailor's hands guiding plain cotton cloth through an old hand-cranked sewing machine, a thin green-and-gold thread bracelet on the wrist, a spool of thread beside it.

motion.prompt: The hands slowly guide the cloth forward under the needle. The needle moves up and down steadily. The camera is fixed.

narration.text: They were tailors. Stitch by stitch, they built a life with their hands.
